# CivInt Canada — API & Documentation Index

> CivInt Canada is Canada's sovereign, AI-native government data layer: one REST + MCP API for
> government datasets (Parliamentary committees, Lobbying Registry, Canada Gazette, CanadaBuys,
> federal/provincial data portals) with built-in SHA-256 verification and provenance audit trails.

- **Pipeline Source:** https://github.com/reverb256/civint
- **API Base URL:** https://civint.lan/api/v1/ (internal network)
- **MCP Endpoint:** https://civint.lan/mcp (SSE transport, internal network)
- **OpenAPI Spec:** /v1/openapi.json
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/reverb256/civint
- **License:** Attribution required. Government data under OGL-C.

---

## Pipeline Modules

CivInt runs 13 data ingestion modules on your K3s cluster via cron jobs:

| Module | Source | Schedule |
|--------|--------|----------|
| Committees (HoC) | ourcommons.ca XML | Daily |
| Senate Committees | sencanada.ca XML | Daily |
| Lobbying Registry | lobbycanada.gc.ca CSV | Monthly |
| Ontario Lobbying | lobbying.ontario.ca CSV | Daily |
| Procurement | open.canada.ca / CanadaBuys | Daily |
| Canada Gazette | gazette.gc.ca | Daily |
| GIC Appointments | open.canada.ca | Weekly |
| Election Advertising | elections.ca | Per election |
| Oversight Bodies | OAG, PBO, Ethics, CRTC | Varies |
| Court Decisions | canlii.ca API | Daily |
| LMIA Data | open.canada.ca | Quarterly |
| Influence Actors | CRA charities, committee data | Weekly |
| Entity Resolution | Cross-source engine | On sweep |

---

## MCP Tools (14 tools)

- `query_gov_data` — Query government data (StatCan, CKAN, provincial portals)
- `fact_check` — Check a claim against government data
- `get_citation` — Retrieve/verify SHA-256 citation hash
- `latest_releases` — Latest government data releases and indicators
- `search_committees` — House and Senate committee evidence, transcripts, proceedings
- `search_corporate` — Lobbying registry, procurement contracts, executive statements
- `search_influence` — Influence actors, CRA charities, think tanks, funding flows
- `search_gazette` — Canada Gazette proposed and enacted regulations
- `search_gic` — Governor-in-Council appointments, salary ranges
- `search_elections` — Elections Canada third-party advertiser registry
- `search_provincial_lobbying` — Ontario, BC, Quebec lobbying registries
- `search_oversight` — OAG, PBO, Ethics Commissioner, CRTC, Competition Bureau
- `search_canlii` — Federal and provincial court decisions, citation graphs
- `search_lmia` — LMIA employer data, TFW program usage by employer
